text:
zoe: Quick copy review for the Eval upload error state. When users upload a JSON eval that fails schema validation we currently show: \"Upload failed: invalid file\". That's unhelpful. Proposing a short, actionable message + one-line hint and a link to the schema.

dan: Strong yes. Need a clear headline + 1-line body with next step. Also surface the field that failed if available (e.g., \"missing 'cases' array\"). Keep toast short but modal can show details.

marin: Draft options:

Option A (toast -> modal):
Headline: \"Eval upload failed: invalid format\"
Body (toast): \"We couldn't parse the file. Open details to see which fields failed.\"
Modal details line: \"Error: missing required property 'cases' at root\"
Primary CTA (modal): \"Fix file and re-upload\"
Secondary CTA: \"Open schema docs\"

Option B (inline toast improved):
Headline: \"Invalid eval file\"
Body: \"This file doesn't match the expected format. Try exporting a sample or check the schema.\"
Primary CTA: \"Download sample\"
Secondary CTA: \"View schema\"

leah: I like B for quick self-serve. For accessibility, ensure the toast is role=alert and that the modal details are keyboard-focusable. For the CTA labels, prefer verbs that start with an action: \"Download sample\" is good. Make sure links have descriptive aria-labels.

zoe: Small UX nuance: when we know the exact error we can show a 1-line inline hint in the toast: e.g., \"Missing 'cases' array\". If it's too long, show truncated with \"Show details\". Also avoid jargon like \"schema\" in the toast — users don't always know what that is. Use \"format\" instead.

dan: Analytics ask: tag events upload_invalid_toast_shown, upload_view_details_clicked, upload_download_sample_clicked. We'll need the error code if provided.

marin: Final handoff copy (toast + modal flow):

Toast headline: \"Invalid eval file\"
Toast body: \"This file doesn't match the expected format. Show details or download a sample.\"
Toast CTA 1: \"Show details\" (opens modal)
Toast CTA 2: \"Download sample\"

Modal title: \"Eval upload details\"
Modal body top: \"Error parsing file: missing required property 'cases'\"
Modal body help: \"Export a sample eval or follow the format guide to fix the file.\"
Modal primary CTA: \"Fix file and re-upload\"
Modal secondary CTA: \"Open format guide\"
Links: \"Download sample eval\" -> /docs/evals#sample

leah: Approve. Accessibility notes to include in PR: toast role=alert, modal role=dialog with aria-modal=true, details region tabbable and labelled, all CTA aria-labels descriptive. Also SR-friendly wording: prefer \"format guide\" over \"schema docs\".

zoe: Thanks all 4cc I'll update Figma copy + add the error-to-analytics mapping in the PR. tagging @engineering for implementation.
